attributes.residual: NONE. fndiff --clean reports EXACT, 0 real diff lines. The prior park's stated HARD BLOCKER - our build allocating a ten-register stmw r22 save set against retail's - is FALSIFIED against the current raw output: size, save set, schedule and every opcode already agree, and the entire residual was fifteen register fields. Three crossings compose it: a clean r28<->r29 transposition of the two callee-saved list webs (+0x20/+0x2c, and the walk step addi r28,r28,4 at +0x380), a paired r4<->r5 argument-scratch transposition across the texture-record fetch (+0x20c-0x21c), and a r23->r24 shift of the record pointer (+0x218/+0x234/+0x28c). The remaining two rows are the dead-after-compare scratch the park named: ours homes an SDA load in the volatile r0 and feeds slwi/cmplwi from it (+0x3c4/+0x3cc and +0x558/+0x55c) where retail uses r4 and r3.
